choice: Rejects with InputError (code INPUT) before any request, for a malformed bbox or one more than 3 degrees wide or tall
text: What does OverpassCameraSource.getCameras do with an invalid or huge bbox?
why: Keeps a bug in a caller from sending a runaway query to Overpass; real calls are at most about 0.6 degrees (API cap 0.5, planner corridor for a 50 km trip)
